description: This PHP class 'Transaction' in the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Mail' handles sending email notifications about customer transactions within the admin panel of an OpenCart project. It loads relevant models and language files, retrieves customer, store, and language information, and constructs an email to notify the customer of a transaction.

classes.name: Transaction
classes.description: Controller class responsible for sending email notifications about customer transactions from the admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method that prepares and schedules an email task to notify a customer of a transaction, including loading models, retrieving data, and enqueuing an email task.
